# Mantra Sports Nederland

> Mantra Sports Nederland (www.mantrasports.nl) is the Dutch-language wholesale and B2B enquiry site for Mantra Sports cricket equipment in the Netherlands and Belgium. It serves cricket clubs, academies, schools and retailers. There is no online checkout: orders are placed by quote. The brand is operated by Mantra Corporation Pty Ltd (Tasmania, Australia).

## What we supply
- English willow cricket bats from Players’ Grade to Grade III: Magnitude, Raptor and Cobra ranges
- Protective gear: batting gloves, wicket-keeping gloves, leg guards, thigh guards, helmets
- Leather cricket balls (red, white, pink, yellow)
- Performance sportswear for teams
- Accessories: grips, kit bags, stumps, training gear

## How to order
- Wholesale enquiry: https://www.mantrasports.nl/wholesale
- B2B partnerships: https://www.mantrasports.nl/b2b
- Become a dealer: https://www.mantrasports.nl/become-a-dealer
- Phone: +1 (385) 601-3759
- WhatsApp: +1 (267) 901-6382

## Key facts
- B2B and wholesale; quotes for club, school, academy and dealer orders
- Ships from Australia, usually within 1–4 business days of payment; delivery to the Netherlands typically 5–14 business days
- Manufacturing defects are replaced
- Related stores: Mantra Sports Australia (https://mantrasports.com.au) and Mantra Sports USA (https://www.mantrasportsusa.com)
